scientific limitations/integrity: The claim concerns only primality of the squarefree kernel \(s(c!)\). The proof uses Nagura's explicit prime-interval theorem for the infinite tail and exact finite checks through \(c=50\); it makes no claim about kernels with two or more prime factors. A plausible older h-free-part source was identified, but its publisher PDF was not retrievable from the indexed link; available metadata and secondary formula summaries concern asymptotics, not this exact classification.
title: Prime squarefree kernels of factorials
